name: Deck.gallery
summary: Curated gallery of 200+ presentation decks and 9,000+ slides, plus a marketplace of editable templates.
description: Free-to-browse library of real pitch decks, brand guidelines, reports, portfolios and talks, with slide-by-slide previews, creator credits and category/industry filters. Pro and Team memberships unlock full slide views; editable presentation templates are sold separately in the marketplace, with checkout handled by Whop.
contains: free tier: today's new deck + 6 slides per archived deck
filters: category (pitch, guideline, report, talks, portfolio, marketing, sales, strategy) and industry
marketplace of editable presentation templates and design assets (separate purchase)
public JSON catalog API with OpenAPI spec
curated by product designer Muharrem Senyil
